title: CGMA® / CIMA Professional Qualification
body: Chartered Institute of Management Accountants & AICPA (AICPA & CIMA)
source: CIMA Professional Qualification Syllabus & Competency Framework
summary: The premier global management accounting qualification featuring a Dual Pathway architecture: the Traditional Exam Route (Cert BA + 9 OTs + 3 Case Studies OCS/MCS/SCS) and the digital Finance Leadership Program (FLP), culminating in ACMA and CGMA designations.

traditional.name: Standard Examination Pathway
traditional.blurb: Complete the Certificate in Business Accounting, 9 Objective Tests across Operational, Management, and Strategic levels, and 3 Integrated Case Study exams.

stages.title: Stage 1: Certificate in Business Accounting (Cert BA) - Foundational Entry
stages.subtitle: 4 Objective Tests (90 Mins Each | 100/150 Pass Mark)

nodes.name: BA1: Fundamentals of Business Economics
nodes.description: Micro/macroeconomic business environment, market structures, international trade, financial markets, and banking systems.
topics: Macroeconomic Environment, Aggregate Demand & Business Cycles
Microeconomic Market Forces: Demand, Supply, Elasticity & Market Forms
Financial Markets, Banking Systems & Monetary/Fiscal Policy Impacts
International Trade, Exchange Rate Determination & Globalization Drivers

nodes.name: BA2: Fundamentals of Management Accounting
nodes.description: Cost identification, cost accounting systems, marginal costing, variance analysis, planning and budgetary control.
topics: Cost Identification, Classification & Cost Accounting Systems
Marginal Costing, Absorption Costing & Contribution Margin Analysis
Budgetary Planning, Operational Budgets & Variance Analysis
Cost-Volume-Profit (CVP) Analysis & Short-Term Commercial Decision Rules

nodes.name: BA3: Fundamentals of Financial Accounting
nodes.description: Accounting principles, double-entry bookkeeping, adjusting entries, and financial statements preparation under IFRS.
topics: Principles of Financial Accounting, Accounting Equation & Bookkeeping
Adjusting Entries, Trial Balance Extraction & Error Corrections
Preparation of Financial Statements under IFRS/IAS for Single Entities
Accounting for Non-Current Assets, Depreciation & Working Capital Balances

nodes.name: BA4: Fundamentals of Ethics, Governance and Law
nodes.description: Ethics and professional behavior, corporate governance frameworks, corporate law, administration, and employment law.
topics: Ethics, Ethical Frameworks & CIMA Code of Professional Ethics
Corporate Governance Principles, Board Responsibilities & Internal Control
Company Law: Incorporation, Share Capital, Directors' Fiduciary Duties
Commercial Contract Law, Employment Law & Professional Negligence Liability

stages.title: Stage 2: Operational Level (Award: CIMA Dip MA)
stages.subtitle: 3 Objective Tests (E1, P1, F1) + Operational Case Study (OCS)

nodes.name: E1: Managing Finance in a Digital World
nodes.description: Finance function organization, technology in finance (cloud, big data, blockchain, AI), and data analytics.
topics: Role, Structure & Evolution of the Modern Corporate Finance Function
Emerging Digital Technologies: Cloud, Big Data, AI, RPA, Blockchain & IoT
Data Ecosystems, Data Management Pipelines, Governance & Cybersecurity Risks
Finance Business Partnering, Stakeholder Collaboration & Digital Transformation

nodes.name: P1: Management Accounting
nodes.description: Cost accounting systems, budgeting, short-term decision making, and managing risk and uncertainty.
topics: Cost Accounting Systems: Marginal, Absorption & Activity-Based Costing (ABC)
Budgeting Frameworks, Flexible Budgets & Rolling Operational Forecasts
Short-Term Decision Making: CVP Analysis, Limiting Factors & Pricing Models
Managing Risk and Uncertainty in Operations: Payoff Tables & Decision Trees

nodes.name: F1: Financial Reporting
nodes.description: Regulatory environment, IFRS financial statements, taxation (corporate income tax and VAT), and working capital management.
topics: Financial Reporting Regulatory Framework & IASB Standard-Setting Architecture
Preparation of Single-Entity Financial Statements under IFRS (IAS 1, 2, 16, 38)
Corporate Income Tax Calculation, Tax Provisions & Indirect Taxation (VAT)
Working Capital Management: Cash Operating Cycles, Receivables & Liquidity

nodes.name: Operational Case Study (OCS)
nodes.description: 3-hour computer-based case simulation evaluating integration of E1, P1, and F1 knowledge in a real-world company context. Passing mark: 80/150.
checklists: Review pre-seen case study materials thoroughly
Demonstrate role competence as a Finance Officer / Cost Accountant
topics: Integrated Scenario Simulation Synthesizing E1, P1, and F1 Competencies
Operational Financial Performance Diagnostics & Cost Variance Reporting
Working Capital Liquidity Troubleshooting & Inventory Management Responses
Preparation of Finance Officer Briefing Memos for Senior Management

stages.title: Stage 3: Management Level (Award: CIMA Adv Dip MA)
stages.subtitle: 3 Objective Tests (E2, P2, F2) + Management Case Study (MCS)

nodes.name: E2: Managing Performance
nodes.description: Business models, value chains, strategic management, project management, and relationship management.
topics: Business Models, Value Creation & Ecosystem Orchestration across Value Chains
Strategic Environmental Scanning (PESTEL, Porter's 5 Forces) & Strategic Options
Project Management Methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, PRINCE2) & Critical Path Method
People Management, High-Performance Teams, Leadership & Change Models (Kotter)

nodes.name: P2: Advanced Management Accounting
nodes.description: Cost management for competitive advantage, control and performance of responsibility centers, and pricing decisions.
topics: Strategic Cost Management: Target Costing, Life-Cycle Costing & Kaizen
Capital Investment Appraisal: Discounted Cash Flow (NPV, IRR, MIRR) & Real Options
Divisional Performance Evaluation: ROI, Residual Income, EVA® & Transfer Pricing
Revenue Management, Dynamic Pricing Strategies & Long-Term Decision Analysis

nodes.name: F2: Advanced Financial Reporting
nodes.description: Group financial statements (IFRS 10/IFRS 3), financial instruments (IFRS 9), revenue recognition, and financial analysis.
topics: Consolidated Financial Statements: Group Accounts, Goodwill & NCIs (IFRS 3, 10)
Accounting for Associates (IAS 28) & Joint Venture Arrangements (IFRS 11)
Complex Financial Instruments (IFRS 9), Leases (IFRS 16) & Revenue (IFRS 15)
Financial Analysis, Ratio Diagnostics, Earnings Quality & Corporate Valuation

nodes.name: Management Case Study (MCS)
nodes.description: 3-hour computer-based case simulation evaluating E2, P2, and F2 integration. Acts as the Gateway Exam for qualified accountants. Passing mark: 80/150.
topics: Integrated Scenario Simulation Synthesizing E2, P2, and F2 Competencies
Capital Investment Project Evaluation & Strategic Financial Recommendations
Group Consolidated Reporting Analysis & Divisional Performance Dispute Resolution
Preparation of Management-Level Strategic Briefing Papers for Executive Directors

stages.title: Stage 4: Strategic Level (Award: ACMA, CGMA)
stages.subtitle: 3 Objective Tests (E3, P3, F3) + Strategic Case Study (SCS)

nodes.name: E3: Strategic Management
nodes.description: Interlocking context of strategy, formulation of strategic options, digital strategy, and implementing business transformation.
topics: Enterprise Strategic Planning: Purpose, Vision, Competitive Strategies & Blue Ocean
Digital Strategy Formulation, Platform Business Models & Disruptive Innovation
Strategy Implementation: Organizational Architecture, Network Models & Controls
Strategic Leadership, Corporate Governance (OECD) & Ethical Board Stewardship

nodes.name: P3: Risk Management
nodes.description: Enterprise risk management, strategic risk, cyber risk, internal controls, and ethical governance.
topics: Enterprise Risk Management (ERM): COSO Framework, Risk Appetite & Registers
Internal Control Systems, SOX Compliance, Fraud Risk Assessment & Internal Audit
Cybersecurity Governance, Information Asset Protection & Business Continuity (BCM)
Financial Risk Management: Currency & Interest Rate Hedging via Derivatives

nodes.name: F3: Financial Strategy
nodes.description: Financial strategy formulation, debt and equity financing, business valuation, and mergers and acquisitions.
topics: Formulation of Strategic Financial Policy & Long-Term Capital Structure
Financing Decisions: Equity Rights Offerings, Debt Instruments & Hybrids
Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A): Target Valuation (DCF, Multiples) & Deal Structuring
Corporate Restructuring, Divestitures, Dividend Policies & Share Repurchases

nodes.name: Strategic Case Study (SCS)
nodes.description: Cap-stone 3-hour executive case study simulating board-level strategic decision-making and risk governance. Passing mark: 80/150.
topics: Capstone Integrated Scenario Simulation Synthesizing E3, P3, and F3
Board-Level Strategic Problem Solving, Financial Engineering & Risk Defense
Evaluating Cross-Border Mergers, Capital Restructuring & Turnaround Proposals
Drafting Boardroom Executive Memos & Strategic Advisory Presentations

stages.title: Stage 5: Practical Experience Requirement (PER) & Membership
stages.subtitle: 36 Months Supervised Practical Experience Mapped to CGMA Competencies

nodes.name: 36 Months Supervised Practical Experience
nodes.description: Document 36 months of verified professional experience across technical accounting, business acumen, people skills, and leadership mapped to the CGMA Competency Framework.
topics: Technical Skills & Business Acumen
People and Leadership Competencies
Professional Ethics in Workplace

nodes.name: Admission as ACMA & CGMA
nodes.description: Formal admission as an Associate Chartered Management Accountant (ACMA) and award of the global Chartered Global Management Accountant (CGMA) designation.
topics: ACMA Designation Conferred
CGMA Global Designation Conferred
Joint AICPA & CIMA Membership

flp.name: Finance Leadership Program (FLP - Digital Accelerated Track)
flp.blurb: Complete competencies via self-paced digital continuous learning assessments, taking only the 3 Integrated Case Study exams (OCS, MCS, SCS).

stages.title: Stage 1: FLP Operational Tier
stages.subtitle: Digital Continuous Learning Modules + Operational Case Study (OCS)

nodes.name: FLP Operational Digital Continuous Learning
nodes.description: Self-paced digital learning platform validating competencies corresponding to E1, P1, and F1 through interactive business scenario assessments.
topics: Digital Finance & Operations
Cost Management Competencies
Financial Reporting Frameworks

nodes.description: Unified Operational Case Study examination milestone shared with the Traditional Pathway.
topics: Integrated Scenario Simulation Synthesizing E1, P1, and F1 Competencies
